summary.text: Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins is a Democrat from Sitka who served ten years in the Alaska House of Representatives and was a member of a bipartisan House coalition.
His campaign focuses on school funding, fisheries and rebuilding the state ferry system, and he has said he would fill his cabinet one-third each with Democrats, independents and Republicans.

paragraphs.text: Kreiss-Tomkins was born and raised in Sitka. He attended Yale University but dropped out to run for the Alaska House of Representatives.
He represented District 35 in Southeast Alaska from 2013 to 2023 and chaired the House State Affairs Committee in the 30th Legislature.

Late in his tenure he co-chaired a bipartisan working group on the state's fiscal crisis, whose recommendations were not implemented, and he was a member of the bipartisan fiscal working group that drafted a long-term fiscal plan in 2021.
